title: 第十一章 摸鱼
content_zh:
京察，大奉京官考核制度，三年一查，以‘四格’、‘八法’为升降标准。
不合格的官员，降级，甚至削职为民。
事关前程，这就好理解了。对方又有个给事中的远方亲戚，回头一弹劾，凉凉。
长乐县积压命案，这是可以成为政敌攻讦理由的。
“怎么死的。”许七安漫不经心的问。
“下乡收租，半夜回来，正好在自家内院遇到梁上君子，给人咔擦了。”一名同僚啧啧道。
“有人证？”许七安道。
“妻子听闻动静，出门查看时，人已经死在院中。不过我们在外墙发现了脚印。”
“有没有可能是仇人伪装成窃贼行凶。”许七安给自己倒了杯茶，从同僚那里拿了几粒蜜饯丢进杯里。
他的语气，就像当初在警局时与同事讨论命案。
“问过妻儿、仆人，街坊邻居也问了，死者近日没有与人结仇。”
“巡夜的士卒问了吗？”
“御刀卫说当晚附近没有可疑人物出没。”
京城有三道城墙，宫城、内城、外城。
外城虽有巡夜士卒，但没有宵禁，城门十二时辰彻夜不关，商贾只要提前做好报备，拿着凭书，便可自由出入城门。
这条制度极大提高了京城的商业贸易，促进了经济发展。
许七安点点头：“这么说来，如果是窃贼的话，应该是对康平街那一块了如指掌的熟人。”
“何以见得？”众衙役一愣。
“贼人能在夜里出入宅子，又不被巡逻的士卒发现，说明是踩过点的，对御刀卫的巡逻规律了然于胸。”许七安一边分析，一边本能的往兜里摸烟。
怅然的摸空了。

不由想起当初在警局任职的时候，那会儿大家也是三三两两的坐在一起，抽着烟，讨论案情。
他也因此近墨者黑，染上烟瘾。
几位同僚吃了一惊，审视着许七安：
“甚是有理。”
“我们怎么没想到这一茬。”
“宁宴，进了一次大狱，人都变机灵了。”
这年头没有系统的教学课程，捕快办案全凭经验，业绩最好的就能当捕头。
“你们没想到，但王捕头肯定想到了，城西那边去问过了吗？”许七安低调不炫耀。
同僚回复：“问了两天，没锁定疑犯。”
城西是贫民窟，尽是些偷鸡摸狗之辈，鱼龙混杂，一般出了治安问题，衙役们带上白役，跑那边，一抓一个准。
“丢了多少银子？”许七安下意识的在脑海里展开推理，问道。
一位同僚看了许七安一眼，觉得他的语气有点县令老爷的味道了，便回答道：“没丢，死者刚收租回来，收上来的都是碎银；铜钱以及米粮，贼人杀人后怎么可能带着大箱的银钱逃走？”
许七安眯了眯眼，如果我是贼人，且踩过点的，那我肯定会选择隔天来偷，而不是今天。
他没把这个疑惑说出来，嗑着瓜子，继续听同僚侃大山。
“可惜了那么娇美的妇人，年纪轻轻就要守活寡。那身段，那胸脯，啧啧，勾栏里都找不到这么出色的女人。就算一两银子睡一晚，我也愿意啊。”
“也不年轻了，只是与那姓张的差了二十岁，似乎三十出头。这种年纪的女人，最守不住寡。”
听到这里，许七安感慨道：“三十岁的妇人好啊，更懂床榻风情，滋味无限。”
一番老成之言，却没有得到同僚们的认可，众人看着他，哄笑打趣：“你一个连勾栏都不去的童子鸡，知道个屁！”
要走武道一途，不突破练气境，就不能破身，元阳一泄，便难开天门了。
所以许七安身怀定海神针十九载，尚未降服过女妖精。

.....
县令老爷居住的后堂。
皮肤黝黑，宛如田埂老农的王捕头低着脑袋，无精打采的听着县令老爷的呵斥。
县令老爷姓朱，富态白胖，燕州人士，元景20年的三甲进士，擅钻营，不擅公务，是个业务能力乏善可陈，但很懂得为官之道的读书人。
优点是还算有良心，小贪不大贪，无能却也不扰民。
缺点是对待下属脾气不好，容易口吐芬芳。
“无能，何等的无能。”
知道王捕头昨天依旧毫无收获，朱县令气坏了。
“你好歹是经验丰富的老手，区区命案，这么多天都毫无头绪。”
王捕头额头沁出汗水，芒刺在背。
京察在即，朱县令愈发暴躁了......李典史不敢插嘴，尽管他与王捕头是十几年的老交情。
李典史知道的，县令老爷一直想再往上升一升，升官需要两个条件：靠山、政绩！
没有政绩，只有靠山，容易被弹劾，位置不稳。
有政绩有靠山，才能四平八稳的上升。
政绩哪里来？
京察就是重要的考核标准。
一刻钟后，朱县令收回目光，端起茶杯喝了一口。
官场规矩，端茶送客！
见状，李典史拉了拉低着头一声不吭的王捕头，两人狼狈离开。
......

王捕头脸色难看的回到休息室，乱糟糟的室内一下子安静下来，大家小心翼翼的看着王捕头。
“头儿，朱县令又骂你了？”
王捕头翻了个白眼，抓起茶盏灌了一口：“他娘的，人死贼走，上哪儿去找？今天忒倒霉了，我还掉了一钱银子。”
那钱是你掉的啊....许七安缩了缩脖子，喝茶掩饰心虚。
银子明显与你无缘。
听完王捕头的抱怨后，一个小捕快给他出了个馊主意：“要不，摸个鱼？”
许七安眉头跳了跳。
摸鱼，底层官场里的专业术语！
意思是：找个替死鬼。
受限于技术和设备，古代的案子，大部分都是无头案，破案率极低。有时候官员捞政绩；上级施压等原因，为了交差，就会找替死鬼来顶替。
过程是这样的，先由本地人的吏员挑选出一批时常作奸犯科的老混子，名字写在纸上折好，官员随手一摸。
摸到谁，谁就是替死鬼。
所以叫做摸鱼。
倒霉鬼锁定后，吏员前去锁人，带回衙门一套名为‘屈打成招’的流水线下来，骨头再硬的人也招了。
上级满意了，中间的官员得了赏识，吏员们得了奖赏，你好我好大家好。
替死鬼也不冤，反正是个烂人，早点送他轮回，也是为周遭百姓谋福祉了。
类似的骚操作在官场里还有很多很多。
王捕头颔首：“只能这样，小李，这事儿你去办，挑几个混些的，年纪大的。”
小李刚要点头，许七安皱眉道：“等等！头儿，此案疑点颇多，并不是无从下手。”
许七安不认这个道理。

尽管已经不当警察好多年，但那时树立的三观仍然健在。
人家虽然是作奸犯科的混子，可罪不至死。就算死有余辜，也是一码归一码。
这边找人顶替，那边岂不是白白便宜了真凶。
王捕头沉下脸，不说话，神态不愉的看了他一眼。
众人纷纷劝说：
“宁宴，你别多事。”
“头儿天天挨骂，也是没办法的事儿，再说，索性就是个经常犯事的混子。”
关系更好些的，则说：“头儿，宁宴家里刚遭遇大难，难免对这类事有些敏感。”
王捕头充耳不闻，盯着许七安，不高兴了，沉着脸：“你告诉我，怎么查！”
“卷宗给我！”许七安直截了当。
content_en:
The Beijing inspection system is based on the Beijing official assessment system, which is conducted every three years, and the "four grids" and "eight methods" are used as the standards for promotion and demotion.
Unqualified officials are demoted or even reduced to civilian positions.
It’s about the future, so that’s understandable. The other party also had a distant relative who was involved in the matter, so he turned around and impeached him.
Changle County has a backlog of murder cases, which can be a reason for criticism by political opponents.
"How did you die?" Xu Qian asked casually.
"I went to the countryside to collect rent, and when I came back in the middle of the night, I happened to meet Mr. Liang Shang in his inner courtyard and was slapped by him." A colleague said with his tongue.
"Is there a witness?" Xu Qian asked.
"My wife heard the noise and went out to check. The man was already dead in the courtyard. However, we found footprints on the outer wall."
"Is it possible that the enemy disguised himself as a thief and committed the murder?" Xu Qian poured himself a cup of tea, took a few candied fruits from his colleagues and threw them into the cup.
His tone was like discussing the murder case with his colleagues at the police station.
"I asked my wife, children, servants, and neighbors. I also found that the deceased had no enemies with anyone recently."
"Did the night watchman ask?"
"Mitai said there were no suspicious people around that night."
The capital has three walls, the palace city, the inner city, and the outer city.
Although there are night patrols in the outer city, there is no curfew. The city gates are open all night at 12 o'clock. Merchants can enter and exit the city gates freely as long as they report in advance and hold the certificate.
This system greatly improved the commercial trade in the capital and promoted economic development.
Xu Qian nodded: "So, if it is a thief, he should be an acquaintance who knows Kangping Street well."
"How come you can see that?" All the officials were stunned.
"The thief can come in and out of the house at night without being discovered by the patrolling soldiers. It means that he has stepped on it a little bit and is familiar with the patrol rules of the sword guards." Xu Qi'an instinctively felt for a cigarette in his pocket while analyzing.
Feeling disappointed.
I couldn't help but think of when I was working in the police station. At that time, everyone sat together in twos and threes, smoking cigarettes and discussing the case.
As a result, he became addicted to smoking.
Several colleagues were surprised and looked at Xu Qian:
"It makes perfect sense."
"Why didn't we think of this?"
"Ning Yan, after being in prison once, people become smarter."
There are no systematic teaching courses these days. Police officers handle cases based on experience, and the one with the best performance can be the head catcher.
"You didn't expect it, but Mr. Wang must have thought of it. Have you gone to the west side of the city to ask?" Xu Qian kept a low profile and did not show off.
The colleague replied: "After asking for two days, the suspect has not been identified."
The west part of the city is a slum, full of sneaky people, good and bad, and there is usually a public security problem. The government officials take the white servants and run there to catch them.
"How much money was lost?" Xu Qian asked subconsciously, reasoning in his mind.
A colleague glanced at Xu Qian and felt that his tone sounded a bit like a county magistrate, so he replied: "It's not lost. The deceased just came back from rent collection, and what was collected was all broken silver, copper coins and rice grains. How could the thief escape with a big box of silver money after killing someone?"
Xu Qian narrowed his eyes. If I were a thief and had stepped on something, I would definitely choose to steal it the next day instead of today.
He did not express his doubts and continued to listen to his colleagues chatting while eating melon seeds.
"It's a pity that such a delicate and beautiful woman has to be left a widow at such a young age. With that figure and those breasts, you can't find such an outstanding woman in the hook bar. Even if I have to pay one tael of silver for a night's sleep, I'm willing to do it."
"She's not younger anymore. She's just 20 years younger than the one named Zhang. She seems to be in her early thirties. Women of this age are most unable to remain widowed."
Hearing this, Xu Qian said with emotion: "A thirty-year-old woman is so good. She understands the style of bed better and has unlimited taste."
His mature words were not recognized by his colleagues. Everyone looked at him, laughed and joked: "You are a child who doesn't even check the fence. You knowWhat the hell! "
If you want to follow the path of martial arts, you will not be able to break through the realm of Qi training. Once the Yuanyang is released, it will be difficult to open the gate of heaven.
Therefore, Xu Qi'an has been carrying the Sea-Dinging Needle for nineteen years and has yet to subdue a female demon.
.....
The back hall where the county magistrate lives.
Wang, who had dark skin and looked like an old farmer on a field, lowered his head and listened listlessly to the scolding of the county magistrate.
The county magistrate's surname is Zhu. He is rich, fair and fat. He is from Yanzhou. He was a top three Jinshi in the 20th year of Yuanjing. He is good at business but not good at official business. He is a scholar who has little business ability but knows how to be an official.
The advantage is that he still has a good conscience, is not greedy but not too greedy, and is incompetent but does not disturb the people.
The disadvantage is that he has a bad temper towards his subordinates and tends to spit out sweet things.
"Incompetent, so incompetent. "
Magistrate Zhu was furious knowing that Mr. Wang still had no results yesterday.
"You are an experienced veteran after all, but you have been clueless for so many days in a mere murder case. "
Sweat broke out on Wang Captou's forehead, and thorns pricked his back.
With the Beijing police approaching, Magistrate Zhu became even more irritable...Li Dianshi did not dare to interrupt, even though he and Wang Baotou had been friends for more than ten years.
Li Dianshi knew that the county magistrate had always wanted to be promoted. Promotion requires two conditions: backing and political performance!
With no political achievements and only a backer, he is easily impeached and his position is unstable.
Only when you have political achievements and a backer can you rise steadily.
Where do political achievements come from?
Jingcha is an important assessment standard.
A quarter of an hour later, Magistrate Zhu withdrew his gaze, picked up the tea cup and took a sip.
Official rules: serve tea to see off guests!
Seeing this, Li Dianshi pulled Wang Baotou, who lowered his head and said nothing, and the two left in embarrassment.
...
Wang Captou returned to the lounge with an ugly expression. The messy room suddenly became quiet, and everyone looked at Wang Captou cautiously.
"Boss, did Magistrate Zhu scold you again? "
Wang Captou rolled his eyes, grabbed the tea cup and took a sip: "Damn it, where can we find someone who is dead and a thief is gone? I was so unlucky today that I lost a penny. "
You dropped that money...Xu Qian shrank his neck and drank tea to hide his guilt.
Silver is obviously not destined for you.
After listening to Captain Wang’s complaints, a young catcher gave him a bad idea: “How about catching a fish? "
Xu Qian's brows twitched.
Fishing, a professional term in the lower-level official circles!
Meaning: Find a scapegoat.
Limited by technology and equipment, most cases in ancient times were unsolved and the detection rate was extremely low. Sometimes officials will find a scapegoat to take their place due to reasons such as seeking political achievements or pressure from superiors.
The process is like this. First, local officials select a group of old gangsters who often commit crimes. Their names are written on paper, folded, and the officials touch it.
Whoever is touched will be the scapegoat.
That’s why it’s called fishing.
After the unlucky person was locked up, the officials went to lock him up and brought back to the Yamen a set of assembly lines called "Bending and Beating into Recruitment". Even the toughest people could be recruited.
The superiors are satisfied, the officials in the middle are appreciated, the clerks are rewarded, hello to me, hello to everyone.
It's not unfair to be a scapegoat. He is a rotten person anyway. Sending him to reincarnation as soon as possible is also for the benefit of the people around him.
There are many, many similar tricks in the officialdom.
Wang Captou nodded: "This is the only way, Xiao Li, you can handle this matter and pick a few who are more mature and older. "
Just when Xiao Li was about to nod, Xu Qian frowned and said, "Wait! Boss, there are many doubts about this case, and it’s not impossible to start. "
Xu Qian didn't recognize this truth.
Although I have not been a police officer for many years, the three views I established at that time are still there.
Although he is a bastard who commits crimes, his crime will not lead to death. Even if you die innocently, you will still get the same code.
If we find someone to replace him here, wouldn't it be that the real culprit is getting an advantage over there?
Wang Baotou lowered his face, said nothing, and gave him an unpleasant look.
Everyone advised:
"Ning Yan, don't be too troublesome. ""There's nothing we can do about the boss getting scolded every day. Besides, he's just a bastard who often gets into trouble."
The person with a better relationship said: "Boss, Ning Yan's family has just suffered a disaster, so it is inevitable that he will be a little sensitive to such things."
Mr. Wang turned a deaf ear and stared at Xu Qian. He was unhappy and said with a sullen face: "Tell me how to check!"
"Give me the file!" Xu Qian said bluntly.
